decoy_chase.hint_text: After-hours accesses are partly faked by the mole (framing), half of them onto the angry decoy, so logs and anger are weak evidence; leaked canary variants are strong evidence.

premature_accusation.hint_text: Before accusing, estimate P(correct) from the evidence: accusing is only worth it if P x V - (1 - P) > 0; otherwise keep investigating, or end without accusing (score 0).
